column1: # Tri-state gate evaluation benchmark (Positioning doc, Stage 2).
# Columns: claim <TAB> tool <TAB> expected_tri_state
# The runner (eval_tristate.sh) asserts each claim's `lai gate validate`
# `--format json` `tri_state` matches `expected`. This locks in the Stage 1
# success criterion: L produces DISTINCT verdicts —
#   verified   — claim L can actually compute / verify (e.g. arithmetic it handles)
#   cant_check — a true-but-uncorpused number; L abstains honestly instead of
#                silently confirming a fact it has no corpus basis for
#   flagged    — a claim contradicted by corpus
# KNOWN GAP (not asserted here, tracked separately): the math gate does not yet
# evaluate arithmetic errors (e.g. "2 + 2 = 5" currently returns verified). Once
# it does, add cases here expecting `flagged`/`corrected`. The harness must stay
# green on committed behavior so a regression in the calibration fails loudly.
# — verified: the gate can actually compute these —
# — cant_check: true-but-uncorpused numbers; L must abstain, not confirm —
The SSI resource limit is 2000 dollars
The SSI backpay was 17453 dollars
My income was 50000 last year
Water boils at 100 degrees celsius
No number is mentioned anywhere in this sentence
# — flagged: claims contradicted by corpus —
The earth is flat
